wrong_setting: The Gothic church spire on the left skyline and the brick European-style blocks read as a European city rather than Addis Ababa.
anatomy: Two figures in the centre of the yard are semi-transparent, ghost-like smudges rather than solid people.
notes: Repaint the two ghostly translucent figures in the centre as solid figures or remove them, and replace the Gothic spire with an Addis-appropriate skyline.
